title: Olfactory stimuli and moonwalker SEZ neurons can drive backward locomotion in Drosophila.
source_locator: Results 'Optogenetic activation of GH146II-, NP225-, and NP5288-GAL4 triggers backward walking'; Figure S2A (mmc1 p.4-5); Figure 2C, 2E-H
quote: Activation of MDNs using both the broad and narrow MDN driver lines indeed elicited sustained backward walking, as previously observed18 (Figure S2A).
mapping_basis: Paper names moonwalker descending neurons (MDNs); MDN is the MANC type name; line MDN3-GAL4 = VT50660-p65ADZp; VT44845-ZpGAL4DBD, same hemidrivers as kit line MDN-1.
sensory_condition: open arena (60 mm), IR illumination, groups of 3-15 flies
penetrance: Fig. 2H: most MDN3>ChR2-XXM flies covered >=3 mm backward (bar near 100%)
notes: Paper calls MDN3-GAL4 the 'narrow split GAL4 driver line' / 'more specific split-GAL4'; no off-target cells named, so coded clean. Backward walking coded yes for all legs per convention (walking forward or backward). Translational velocity tracked (Ctrax), no leg tracking. effect_on_walking not_assessed because flies were a mix of walking/standing and the effect is a reversal to backward walking (no vocabulary value). Fig. 2C trajectories show persistent backward retreat.

title: Olfactory stimuli and moonwalker SEZ neurons can drive backward locomotion in Drosophila.
source_locator: Results 'Backward locomotion induced by GH146II has MDN-dependent and -independent components'; Figure 3B (control trace without TNT); Video S3
quote: As expected, TNT efficiently silenced MDNs and eliminated backward walking (Figure 3B; Video S3).
mapping_basis: Paper names moonwalker descending neurons (MDNs) labelled by VT50660-GAL4; MDN is the MANC type name.
notes: figure: the activation result (no TNT) is shown in Fig. 3B: genotype 'VT50660-GAL4 (MDNs)>UAS-CsChrimson, MDN-LexA' has translational velocity ~-5 mm/s during the 2-s light pulse (legend: 'TNT in MDNs completely blocks backward walking'); the text quote implies backward walking without TNT (positive control). Separate figure/effector from records 0002/0004.

coordination_notes: straight backward walking with low angular speed (Fig. 7H-J)
notes: Long (30 s) bilateral MDN activation; outcome same as 2-s activation (straight backward walking), recorded separately because it is a different figure and stimulus duration.

title: Olfactory stimuli and moonwalker SEZ neurons can drive backward locomotion in Drosophila.
source_locator: Figure 3E (and 3D legend); Results 'Backward locomotion induced by GH146II has MDN-dependent and -independent components'
quote: Backward locomotion is not reduced in flies expressing TNT in GH146II-GAL4 neurons upon light stimulation of MDNs and MANs
mapping_basis: Paper names MDNs (co-activated with moonwalker ascending neurons, MANs) via the split MDN+MAN-LexA line; MDN is the MANC type name.
notes: figure: Fig. 3E shows both 'UAS-TNT, MDN+MAN-LexA>LexAop-CsChrimson' (no GAL4, light blue) and the GH146II-GAL4>UAS-TNT version (dark blue) with translational velocity ~-4 mm/s during the light pulse; the control without GAL4 is the cleanest MDN+MAN activation. MANs are ascending, not DNs, hence minor_offtarget. Not recorded: Fig. 3D (MDN+MAN activation while MDNs are silenced with TNT), which tests MDN necessity rather than MDN activation.
